Title: Health check
Expected result: Success status code (documented: 201 Created) and body "Created"

Title: Get token with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Send POST /auth with valid username and password
Expected result: Status 200 and a token is returned in the response body
Actual result: Token returned in the response body

Title: Get token with invalid credentials
Steps: 1. Send POST /auth with a wrong password
Expected result: No token is returned; the response indicates bad credentials
Actual result: 200 OK, body {"reason": "Bad credentials"}, no token (note: 200 instead of the more usual 401)

Title: List all booking IDs
Expected result: Status 200 and a list of objects containing bookingid
Actual result: 200 OK, list of objects containing bookingid

Title: Get booking by valid ID
Steps: 1. Create a booking 2. Send GET /booking/{id} with the returned ID
Expected result: Status 200 and all booking fields match the created data
Actual result: 200 OK, booking 2327 returned, all fields match the created data

Title: Get booking with non-existent ID
Steps: 1. Send GET /booking/{id} with an ID that does not exist

Title: Create booking with valid data
Steps: 1. Send POST /booking with a complete valid payload
Expected result: Status 200; response contains bookingid and a booking object matching the payload
Actual result: 200 OK, bookingid 4157, booking object matches the payload

Title: Create booking with missing required field
Steps: 1. Send POST /booking without the lastname field
Expected result: The request is rejected with a 4xx client error and no booking is created
Actual result: 500 Internal Server Error, body "Internal Server Error"

Title: Create booking with checkout date before checkin date
Steps: 1. Send POST /booking where checkout is earlier than checkin
Expected result: The request is rejected or the invalid dates are flagged
Actual result: 200 OK, booking 4197 created with checkin 2026-12-10 and checkout 2026-12-01

Title: Update booking (PUT) with valid token
Precondition: A booking exists; valid token obtained
Steps: 1. Send PUT /booking/{id} with the token and a full updated payload
Expected result: Status 200 and the booking contains the updated data
Actual result: 200 OK, firstname updated to James, other fields unchanged

Title: Partial update (PATCH) of firstname
Precondition: A booking exists; valid token obtained
Expected result: Status 200; only firstname changed, other fields unchanged
Actual result: 200 OK, firstname changed to Alex, other fields unchanged

Title: Delete booking with valid token
Precondition: A booking exists; valid token obtained
Steps: 1. Send DELETE /booking/{id} with the token 2. Send GET /booking/{id}
Expected result: Delete succeeds (documented: 201 Created) and the following GET returns 404
Actual result: DELETE returned 201 Created; the following GET returned 404 Not Found

Title: Filter bookings by firstname
Steps: 1. Create a booking with a unique firstname 2. Send GET /booking?firstname={name}
Expected result: Status 200 and the list contains the created booking
Actual result: 200 OK, list contained only the created booking 1662
